events.text: {"verdict":"finish","decision":"Don't wait on Adi; the deploy was already approved on 2026-10-11T06:57 and has probably happened. 1) Run `git merge-base --is-ancestor 51c7ee1 <deployed commit>` for the live Worker (T-223 says a9f57c7a, T-261 says 7f8bfc45 from 97096ab; check `wrangler deployments list`). 2) If 51c7ee1 is not live, deploy revops-centre from a clean detached worktree of main. 3) On production, POST [email] to /cal/issue and /intake. Then read GET /admin/api/calendar using the auth flow in cloud/src/index.ts and the key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key. Confirm no new attendee, no session_sync row and Zoom failed 0. 4) Clear the 'Asked of Adi' section. Log the Worker version, commit and probe counts. Note that attendees 5 and 66 are no longer in the centre, so the mark-as-test criterion is met.
